_comment: MOCK FIXTURE - Example CardFlow internal card entity structure
_note: This represents how CardFlow stores card catalog data internally, mapping TCGdex metadata to CardFlow's owned schema

catalog.name: Furret

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

catalog.description: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

_separation_of_concerns._comment: The following data is NOT stored in this CardFlowCard entity. It lives in separate tables/entities:
_separation_of_concerns._inventory: UserCardInventoryItem - Links user → card with quantity, condition, purchase date/price, location, notes
_separation_of_concerns._pricing: PriceSnapshot - Stores historical market prices per card (CardFlow's own price tracking, NOT from TCGdex)
_separation_of_concerns._listings: ListingDraft - Stores user's marketplace listing details (price, platform, status, description)
